minutes.headline: Agricultural Commission adjourned after backing Jorge's reappointment and planning a farm promotion flyer; no budget action.
minutes.summary: The commission heard open discussion on a neighbor horse-farm complaint, chickens in a homeowners association, and an APR purchase. It discussed Jorge's expiring term, a draft flyer promoting local farms, farm-size bylaw references, farmers market vendors and a possible social media presence. The only formal vote was to adjourn by roll call.

what_happened.line: The Agricultural Commission cast one formal vote, a roll-call vote to adjourn, and took no budget action.
The chair will email the town a recommendation to reappoint Jorge, ahead of the select board process.
A draft flyer promoting local farms will be prepared with Chris and brought back for approval before printing.
The commission discussed a reduced town share of an agricultural preservation restriction (APR) purchase for a tree farm, described as a saving to the town.
Members decided not to spend money on farmers market signs, and discussed farm-size bylaw references with no resolution.

why_it_matters: Reappointment of a commission member and the town's share of farmland preservation purchases are the parts of this meeting that touch town decisions, though none was voted on here.
The farm-size bylaw discussion was left open and a possible warrant article was raised, which would be a vote residents are asked to take at town meeting if it proceeds.
watch_next: Next commission meeting on May 20, where the flyer draft is due for approval.
Select board action on the reappointment recommendation for Jorge.
